faqs.question: What is Duotail Email Address Proxy?
faqs.answer: *Duotail Email Address Proxy* is a comprehensive solution that grants users total control over their inboxes and incoming communications. By acting as a secure shield, our proxy addresses protect your personal inbox from spam and safeguard your digital privacy.

faqs.question: How does our service differ from other email forwarding providers?
faqs.answer:
There are three fundamental differences:

  • Approved Senders Only: Only emails from addresses you have explicitly approved will be forwarded. All other traffic is automatically filtered out.
  • Silent Reception: All incoming emails are either saved, dropped, or forwarded without ever notifying the original sender, maintaining your total anonymity.
  • Prefix-Based Ownership: All email addresses sharing the same unique prefix are assigned exclusively to a single customer, allowing for easy management of multiple aliases.

faqs.question: Is my personal email address exposed when using the Email Address Proxy?
faqs.answer: No. Your personal email address remains completely private. Our service acts as a secure intermediary, routing all communications through your proxy addresses so that senders never see your actual inbox.

faqs.question: Is this a **burner** email service?
faqs.answer: No. Although you have the flexibility to stop using an address whenever you choose, our service is built for long-term use. Our goal is to provide secure, permanent email addresses that serve as your permanent digital identity while keeping your personal inbox shielded.

faqs.question: Do I need to configure anything in my personal email account?
faqs.answer: No, there is no technical configuration required on your personal account. However, to ensure seamless delivery, we highly recommend adding the *duotail.com* domain to your email provider's "Safe Senders" list. This prevents our forwarded messages from being accidentally flagged as spam.

faqs.question: Can I use this for standard, unrestricted email forwarding?
faqs.answer: Our service functions differently than a traditional forwarding provider. To protect your privacy and prevent spam, we do not forward all incoming mail by default. Instead, we use a *permission-based system* where only approved senders reach your inbox. If you require unrestricted forwarding without these security layers, a standard email provider may be a better fit.

faqs.question: Do you store my emails?
faqs.answer:
To ensure reliability, we retain a copy of all processed emails for 30 days. This allows you to download the original content in the rare event of a processing or delivery failure.
For our *Paid Plan* users, we provide this storage for all emails sent to existing channels or routes. This ensures you can still access and review messages that were not forwarded to your personal inbox (such as those that were "Saved" but not "Sent").
We are actively developing a feature that will allow customers to *opt out* of server-side storage entirely. In the meantime, you can permanently delete any stored records at any time via the *History* page. We maintain a strict privacy policy: *we never view your email content unless you provide explicit permission for support purposes.*

faqs.question: Can I send emails from my email address?
faqs.answer: Only verified or paid customers can send emails from their email addresses. This is to prevent abuse of our service and ensure that only legitimate users can use the email addresses provided by our service.
